description: Each lyric's distance to its OWN source's (human or AI) centroid within its genre, instead of the pooled centroid.

2000x resampling, each genre downsampled to equal human/AI n (seed=20261007); per-genre balanced n: {'country': 18, 'electronic/dance': 29, 'hip-hop/rap': 56, 'pop': 78, 'r&b/soul': 18, 'rock/alternative': 14}; centroid recomputed fresh within each resample (pooled per genre, same definition as primary, just on the balanced subsample); unadjusted AI-human mean difference reported, matching the existing bootstrap check's convention in src/08_robustness.py.

Chunk embeddings combined via a word-count-weighted mean (instead of the primary unweighted mean) before L2 normalization, same embedding model (all-mpnet-base-v2), pooled genre centroid as in the primary definition.
Same pooled-centroid, unweighted-chunk-mean definition as primary, but embedded with sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 instead of all-mpnet-base-v2.
